coverage_notes: P0052: Section 7.7’s indemnify, defend, and hold-harmless obligation is in scope as operative material but cannot be represented using the allowed activities and objects; the unmatched action is indemnifying and defending DeepSeek and specified related parties against qualifying third-party claims.

P0053: The responsibility allocation for decisions or actions based on Outputs and their consequences is operative but cannot be represented using the allowed activities and objects. The existing output_ai_disclosure anchor covers the disclosure duty only.

paragraph_audit.reason: Section 7.7 expressly requires the licensee to indemnify, defend, and hold DeepSeek and specified related parties harmless for qualifying third-party claims, subject to the stated triggers and applicable law. This unmatched indemnification action cannot be represented with an allowed activity/object combination.

The existing anchor covers the requirement to disclose to end users that Outputs are AI-generated, may contain errors or omissions, and are for reference only. The paragraph also assigns the licensee and/or end users sole and independent responsibility for decisions or actions based on Outputs and their consequences; that responsibility allocation cannot be faithfully represented using the allowed activities and objects.
